safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated lists Clenil but does not document baseline dosing of 2 puffs twice daily prior to up-titration.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the patient’s baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs twice daily) removes an important reference point for judging severity of the exacerbation and the magnitude of any step-up therapy. This can lead to confusion in follow-up about what the patient was previously taking and whether subsequent dosing changes were appropriate.
